title: Choose a calmer post-login workspace
question: Six light-first structures keep Mars Bank’s identity and behavior while replacing the harsh condensed register with a quieter banking interface. The last three explore row-level task patterns.

options.label: Quiet Account Workspace
options.thesis: One centered account sheet carries the daily banking task, with navigation receding into a slim graphite rail.
options.viewport: A 72px graphite icon rail and compact utility bar frame a generous greeting, restrained total, and one dominant accounts table with recent movement reduced to a narrow footer strip.
options.risk: The extreme calm depends on disciplined spacing; adding secondary panels would quickly weaken it.

options.label: Grouped Balance Sheet
options.thesis: Accounts read as three spacious financial groups instead of one dense institutional register.
options.viewport: A 200px text rail sits beside a warm light canvas where Spend, Save, and Borrow appear as stacked open bands, each with one decisive balance and minimal metadata.
options.risk: Grouping improves comprehension but gives up some at-a-glance column comparison.

options.label: Search-led Account Desk
options.thesis: A useful search bar and a familiar account table make the interface feel immediate, conventional, and calm.
options.viewport: A black top bar holds the Mars Bank mark, universal search, customer controls, and logout; a narrow icon rail leads to a large white accounts table below a sentence-case greeting.
options.risk: It is the closest to the reference and therefore the least distinctive of the three.

options.label: Row Task Menu
options.thesis: Every account row carries its own quiet task menu, so transactions, statements, details, and transfers start where the account already is.
options.viewport: A calm greeting sits above one white accounts table; the hovered row lifts a hairline-bordered menu listing account transactions, statements, details, and transfer, with row checkboxes enabling a batch statement action in the table header.
options.risk: Menus hide actions behind a click, so the labels have to be exact for the pattern to feel faster than links.

options.label: Expanding Account Rows
options.thesis: The overview stays a single short list until a row opens in place to reveal its card, recent movement, and actions.
options.viewport: Four collapsed account rows on a white sheet, the first expanded to show the linked card, five recent movements, and three text actions, keeping the whole bank on one screen without a second page.
options.risk: An expanded row pushes lower accounts off screen, so the collapsed rhythm has to stay very short.

options.label: Two-pane Account Desk
options.thesis: The account list never leaves the screen; selecting an account fills a persistent detail pane beside it.
options.viewport: A narrow icon rail, then a 320px account list with balances, then a wide white detail pane showing the selected account’s balance, movements, and actions with no page transition.
options.risk: Two panes cost horizontal room, so the detail pane must degrade to a stacked view earlier than the other concepts.
